attchmntText: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "Q2 Results 30-09-2026 News Paper  Cutting".
voiceSummary: Ahluwalia Contracts India Limited has filed a copy of newspaper cuttings containing the un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express and Jansatta on November 15, 2026. This filing is in compliance with Regulation 47(1) of SEBI Listing Regulations 2015. The company shares are listed on BSE Limited with scrip code 532811 and on the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd with symbol AH LU CONT. The information is also available on the company website at www.acilnet.com and on the websites of BSE Limited and NSE India Ltd. The compliance officer has requested the exchanges to take the information on record.

attchmntText: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ahluwalia Contracts India Limited presented Q2 FY 27 results on 14th November 2026. Total income for Q2 FY 27 was Rs. 14,637 Mn, with EBITDA at Rs. 1,109 Mn. Year to date order inflows stood at Rs. 5,581 Mn. As of 30th September 2026, the gross order book was Rs. 298,724 Mn, and the unexecuted order book was Rs. 196,279 Mn. The company operates 55 ongoing projects across 16 states and one project overseas. Key ongoing projects include the Central Vista Project valued at Rs. 26,014 Mn and the India Jewellery Park in Mumbai valued at Rs. 21,570 Mn. For the full year ended 2026, total income was Rs. 45,652 Mn and EBITDA was Rs. 4,345 Mn. Net worth crossed Rs. 20 billion in 2026.

Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Ahluwalia Contracts India Limited has announced the resignation of Mr. Vipin Kumar Tiwari as Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer, effective November 14, 2026. Concurrently, the Board of Directors appointed Mr. Sanjay Bharti, FCS number 5835, to the same position, also effective November 14, 2026. This decision was taken during a Board meeting held on November 14, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Bharti is a qualified Company Secretary and law graduate with 24 years of experience in corporate sectors. The company has filed this intimation with the BSE, NSE, and Calcutta Stock Exchange pursuant to SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ahluwalia Contracts India Limited approved its Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a consolidated net profit of 5608.91 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, compared to 7856.69 Lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 146366.45 Lakhs for the quarter. Earnings per share were 8.37 Rupees. The Board also noted the cessation of Vipin Kumar Tiwari as Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer effective 14 November 2026. Mr. Sanjay Bharti was appointed as the new Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer with the same effective date. The meeting was held on 14 November 2026.

attchmntText: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Ahluwalia Contracts India Limited has scheduled an investor and analyst call for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 4.00 pm. The meeting will discuss operational and financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Company representatives include Shobhit Uppal, Vikas Ahluwalia, and Satbeer Singh. The call is moderated by Sudeep Bora of Ambit Capital. Participants can join via DiamondPass using primary access numbers plus 91 22 6280 1148 and plus 91 22 7115 8049. International toll-free numbers are available for Singapore, Hong Kong, USA, and UK. Discussions will be based on generally available information. No price sensitive information will be shared. The schedule is subject to change.
